code_examples.section: ltm rule event WS CLIENT FRAME DONE
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

WS_CLIENT_FRAME_DONE
       This event is raised to indicate the end of a Websocket frame received on client side.

DESCRIPTION
       This event is raised to indicate the end of a Websocket frame received from the client.

Examples
	when WS_CLIENT_FRAME_DONE {
	    WS::disconnect 1000 "some random reason"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.1.0
	   --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
